description: Block a human profile from applying to your bounties. Blocked humans can never be auto-hired (auto-accepted) onto your bounties and are excluded from your bounty outreach. Blocking a human removes them from your preferred humans list. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

humanId.description: The unique ID of the human profile to block
humanId.title: maxLength(200)

reason.description: Optional private block reason, maximum 280 characters
reason.title: maxLength(280)

name: block_human
